listings.description: An exciting opportunity to acquire an established online tourism and accommodation advertising platform serving one of Cornwall’s most popular visitor destinations. The business generates recurring income through annual advertising subscriptions from holiday accommodation providers and local businesses, providing a cost-effective alternative to traditional commission-based booking platforms. Fully home-based and with very low operating overheads, the business can be operated from anywhere in the UK and would suit an owner-operator, digital entrepreneur, tourism business or an existing marketing/SEO company looking for a complementary bolt-on acquisition. Key Investment Highlights Established online tourism platform Recurring annual subscription income Strong customer retention, with approximately 90% annual renewals Accommodation and local business advertiser base Approximately 4,000–5,000 monthly website visitors Weekly social media reach of approximately 20,000–25,000 No booking commissions charged to accommodation providers Low operating overheads Fully home-based and relocatable Growing 2026 trading performance Significant scope for further expansion Business Model The business generates revenue through annual listing and advertising packages purchased by accommodation providers and local businesses. Rather than charging accommodation providers commission on bookings, the platform enables guests to make enquiries directly with property owners. This provides advertisers with a simple and cost-effective route to market while encouraging long-term customer relationships. Growth Opportunities There is considerable opportunity for a new owner to further develop the business through increased SEO and Google visibility, paid digital advertising, expanded social media marketing, premium advertising packages and expansion into additional tourism destinations. There is also potential to further develop the existing subscription model or introduce additional membership and commission-based revenue streams.

listings.description: Following eight successful years of operation, Blue River Table is for sale as an established and highly regarded hospitality and water-based experience business. Operating from Mylor Yacht Harbour, Blue River Table offers a truly unique dining experience for up to 12 guests, renowned for banquet-style feasts of locally sourced produce while cruising the stunning waterways of the Carrick Roads. At the heart of the business is Tethra, a beautifully converted traditional Cornish motor launch. Built in 1971 and extensively refitted in 2018, she combines classic character with modern systems and comforts, including a new engine installed in 2022. Fully equipped and operational, Tethra is in immaculate condition and offers a versatile and luxury venue for dining, private events, and celebrations, supported by an established reputation, strong repeat business, and a loyal client base built over many years. Business Highlights – Established brand with an excellent reputation and repeat clientele – Unique venue suitable for a wide range of events – Traditional Cornish motor launch converted for bespoke dining experiences – An exclusive way to experience the Cornish waterways – Fully equipped galley and adaptable event space – Coded to run in the Carrick Roads and Helford – Licensed bar onboard with fully commercial operation – VAT Registered, trips are classed as zero registered for VAT, so the business is in a VAT refund position every quarter. A Flexible Opportunity – Continue a proven and successful dining experience – Expand or integrate into an existing hospitality business – Develop new commercial opportunities on the water – Enjoy private use of a unique and characterful vessel For more information and specifications about the boat, please follow this link: https://www.red-ensign.com/brokerage/curtis-and-pape-36/
